items.title: Subtitles your way
items.text: Outline and shadow, six fonts and bold, and one press brings them back in sync. Arabic joins and reads right to left as it should.

items.title: Skip intro, recap and credits
items.text: A button shows up at the right moment: press OK, or let it skip by itself.

items.title: Trailers on the whole screen
items.text: Five seconds in, the trailer fills the screen. Press any key and the page is back at once.

items.title: Cleaner, faster search
items.text: Real films and series only: no clips, fan uploads or adult titles.

items.title: Arabic from end to end
items.text: The whole app in Arabic or English, and titles and descriptions in the language you choose.

items.title: No spoilers
items.text: Blur unwatched episodes keeps their pictures and stories hidden until you watch them.
